name: Eugene
source:
Leader of the Gekkou Knight Troupe.
A pretty but somewhat fickle young man.
He has a deep connection to [url=/c43962]Levias[/url] often bordering on the fanatic.
He dotes on [url=/c43966]Runo[/url] and sees the protagonist as a rival.
